abstract: Production skill for MiniMax's Token Plan web search API. Turns natural-language requests into focused Google-style queries with compact, cited results, and documents live-measured limits from 2026-10-18: at most 10 results, a 32-word effective query, a 2,048-character cap, one honoured site: operator, HTTP 200 base_resp errors including 1027 for zero results, a ~52-per-minute rate limit, and general-bucket quota accounting.
